kb_articles.title: Printer shows offline
kb_articles.body: 1. Check the printer is powered on and has no error on its panel. 2. Confirm it is on the office network (print a network config page). 3. On your laptop, remove and re-add the printer from Settings > Printers. 4. If several people are affected, the print server may need a restart: escalate to Facilities IT.

kb_articles.title: Laptop will not charge
kb_articles.body: Try a different outlet and a known-good charger. Hold the power button for 15 seconds to reset the power controller. If the battery icon shows 'service recommended', request a battery replacement.

kb_articles.title: Cannot connect to office Wi-Fi
kb_articles.body: Forget the 'Corp-WiFi' network and reconnect using your SSO credentials. Make sure your device certificate is not expired (Settings > Device Management). Guests should use 'Corp-Guest' instead.

kb_articles.title: VPN connects but no internal sites load
kb_articles.body: Disconnect and reconnect the VPN client. Flush DNS (macOS: sudo dscacheutil -flushcache). If internal sites still fail, check the status page for a VPN gateway incident.

kb_articles.title: Password reset
kb_articles.body: Use the self-service portal at id.example.com/reset. You will need your registered MFA device. Passwords must be 14+ characters and cannot reuse your last 5 passwords.

kb_articles.title: Locked out after too many MFA attempts
kb_articles.body: Accounts unlock automatically after 30 minutes. If you need access sooner, the helpdesk can unlock you after verifying your identity over a video call.

kb_articles.title: Requesting a software install
kb_articles.body: Install approved apps from the Self Service app. For software not in the catalog, open a request with the business justification; licensing approval takes 2-3 business days.

kb_articles.title: Email client not syncing
kb_articles.body: Quit and reopen the mail client. Check you have free disk space. Remove and re-add the account if sync is stuck for more than an hour. Webmail still works during client issues.

kb_articles.title: Reporting a phishing email
kb_articles.body: Do not click links or open attachments. Use the 'Report Phishing' button in your mail client. If you already entered your password, reset it immediately and tell the security team: this is high severity.

kb_articles.title: Lost or stolen laptop
kb_articles.body: Report it to the security team immediately so the device can be remotely locked and wiped. File a police report for stolen devices. This is always high severity.
